permutation.null: No within-task score/outcome association in every outer fold
permutation.assumption: Within-task label exchangeability conditional on the held-out fold scorer

H2.conditional_population: Held-out tasks with both correct and incorrect eligible attempts

fixed_effects.interpretation: Complementary inference on OOF scores; not an out-of-sample fitted predictor

signal.interval_scope: Task bootstrap conditional on fitted OOF scorers; overlapping training folds are not refitted

H3.interpretation: Predeclared diagnostic only; no operational benefit claim when H2 is unsupported

policies.wall_clock_savings: Not inferred from token replay; require online timing
policies.accounting: Completion tokens only; prompt-prefill tokens and verification times are separate

robustness: Run MBPP+ only after the main pipeline has passed its gates

provenance.advisor_approval: See execution authorization; not inferred from execution
